name: Tomatillo
description: Tart green fruit in a papery husk — the base of every salsa verde.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a nightshade; read with tomato, which is cool.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; sour and read as shita.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the nightshades.

histamine.note: A nightshade like tomato, and sour — tomato is one of the highest fresh foods on the SIGHI list.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
